units_correction: The function named words counts set bits of the OR-reduced 25 lane differences, so theta5_words=1600 denotes 1600 bit coordinates, not 1600 machine words.
aggregation_boundary: Both functions OR across the message-group axis first. Saved footprints describe the union over 256 groups in the historical driver, not necessarily every individual message.
scope: Five two-group synthetic fixtures on two extracted helpers. Original driver, family generator, rounds and 256-group campaign were not executed. No universal rotation-symmetry or key-price result is established.
